'''Gallorr's Light Repair Shed''' was a repair and maintenance shop located in the town of [[Corestrike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]]. Run by [[Mortris Gallorr]], it offered services repairing and maintaining small vehicles and agricultural equipment. Gallorr's son, [[Arno Gallorr|Arno]] and grandson, [[Selmar Gallorr|Selmar]] also worked in the workshop.<ref name="HNNA" />
